statute_note: Principal source selected: the consolidated 2024 PDF (statutes/38-2014-land-restrictions-on-alienation-act-consolidated-2024.pdf, 16 pp, text layer, two-column, chain header to Act No. 21 of 2018), parsed with parse_consolidated_pdf.py and hand-corrected (s.11 heading; earlier rounds recorded in canonical-overrides.json). It states no publisher; the earlier Government Printer attribution is withdrawn in the tree and proposed for withdrawal in the override. Other sources inspected: the registry's RGD PDF of the Act as enacted (20 pp, scan, no text layer; title page read, certified 29th October 2014), carried as a verification source, not parsed, so no original-edition tree exists; Government Printer PDF of Act 3 of 2017 (text layer) and Government Printer scan of Act 21 of 2018 with its OCR sidecar, all carried; LankaLaw HTML copies of both amending Acts, truncated behind the subscription banner, inspected and not used. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 21 of 2018. Review performed: earlier passes recorded in canonical-overrides.json (page-by-page read of the consolidated PDF; amending Acts checked against their PDFs). This pass: the three finalized trees diffed against their canonical parses (principal: raw_text spacing and cross-reference pruning only; 3-2017 and 21-2018: hand corrections with provenance); the four sections and both quoted insertions of Act 21 of 2018 compared word for word with the scan rendered at 170 dpi, no disagreement; s.3(1)(b), (h), (i) and s.5A of the consolidated text checked against the operations of both amending Acts. Amendment coverage: 2 reconciliation rows, both already incorporated in the baseline; nothing applied. OCR or structural weaknesses: Act 21 of 2018 ss. 3 and 4 are attested only by the scan (two readings of one image, no text-layer copy). The consolidated PDF is of unknown provenance beyond 'supplied by the team'. Missing sources: a text-layer copy of the Act as enacted; a text-layer copy of Act 21 of 2018. Unresolved questions: who produced the consolidated 2024 PDF; the amendment-overrides.json wording for 21-2018 (see source_conflicts). Lawyer verification: unverified.
